title: CRM and team workspace
summary: Shared people and companies, deals and sprint tasks, team access and internal notes in one workspace.

entryPoints.summary: Sign in, or create an account that a workspace owner can then add to a team.
Create a workspace, or add, change and remove the people in it.
Keep people and companies with their notes and change history.
Move deals and sprint tasks through the workspace's own stages, New, In progress and Won to begin with.
Open the list of internal records kept for the team.
Search, add, edit and export the team's internal notes.
The app owner changes their own sign-in email and password.
Ask for a password reset link, which is sent only when email is on.
Choose a new password from a one-time reset link.

owner.summary: App owner settings. Workspace access still requires local membership.

member.summary: Unassigned until they create a workspace or its owner adds them.

manager.summary: Any signed-up account that creates a workspace manages it: adds, changes and removes its people.

editor.summary: Added by a workspace manager; reads and changes that one workspace.

viewer.summary: Added by a workspace manager; reads that one workspace and changes nothing.

journeys.summary: Adds a company, person, note and history.
Adds a task, moves it and edits its details.
Adds, edits and searches internal notes.
Adds an existing account with read-only access.
Signs in to an existing team account.
Opens owner settings through the owner pass.
Shows plainly that password reset needs email.
Receives a password reset link at a verified email address.

notIncluded: Password reset delivery and email verification need the email module and a configured sender; off by default.
Signed-in password changes for members are not included.
Going live needs a platform live database, off by default.
Attachments, email invites, reminders, external connections and imports need platform capabilities.
One organisation per account; no organisation switching, ownership transfer or organisation deletion.
Board owners are text labels, not account assignments; deals have an optional renewal date but no sprint periods.
No payments, subscriptions, outbound messages or vendor connections.
